message:
Fixed. "Crème brûlée recipes" now becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including the accent test that was failing.

The change is in `src/blog/slug.js`. The title is decomposed (NFD) and the combining accent marks are removed before it goes to the vendored `slugify`. Before, the vendored code was dropping the accented characters entirely, which is why the output was `crme-brle-recipes`.

I didn't touch `vendor/`, per CLAUDE.md. The shop URL helper (`src/shop/product-url.js`) also calls the vendored `slugify` without this step, so product names with accents will still lose letters. I left it alone because it's outside this task. Say if you want the same fix applied there.
